newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-DANISH CHAMPIONS BRONDBY FINISH IN STYLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DANISH CHAMPIONS BRONDBY FINISH IN STYLE.

text.p: Danish league champions Brondby finished the season in winning style on Sunday with a 2-1 victory over Herfoelge.
Brondby, who clinched the title at the start of the month with a 3-2 victory against Aarhus, finished 14 points clear of their nearest rivals Vejle. Aarhus were third.
Brondby, who now advance to next season's European Cup, reached the quarter-finals of the UEFA Cup earlier this year before falling to Tenerife of Spain.
They failed to advance beyond the qualifying round of the European Cup last year, falling to Polish club Widzew Lodz.
Viborg and Hvidovre were relegated to the first division and will be replaced in the superleague next season by Ikast and Aarhus Fremad.
